name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Log Size Ratio (affine)
details: Every finite nontrivial binary class satisfies $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)\geq\tfrac12\,\log(|\mathcal H|-1)/\log(n+1)$, where $n$ is the ambient domain size.
proof: If the effective range has size at least two, the no-clashing counting bound gives $\mathrm{NCTD}\geq\log|\mathcal H|/(2\log\mathrm E)$. Since $\mathrm E\leq n$ and $\log(|\mathcal H|-1)\leq\log|\mathcal H|$, this dominates one half of the log size ratio. If $\mathrm E=1$, a nontrivial binary class has two concepts and the log size ratio is zero, so the claim is immediate.
proof_source: Corollary cor:nctd-low-log-size-ratio in the LaTeX survey.
